jobs.title: AI Solutions Support Lead
jobs.description: This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry. At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations. **How does this role contribute to our collective success?** AI solutions are becoming increasingly important to AXIS' ability to drive efficiency, improve decision making, and enhance customer and employee experiences. As AI capabilities mature and move into production, maintaining their effectiveness, reliability, fairness, and business value becomes critical. The AI Solutions Support Lead is responsible for the ongoing support, maintenance, monitoring, and enhancement of AI solutions that have been deployed into production. Once an AI solution has been delivered and transitioned from the Data Science \& AI Delivery team, ownership of day\-to\-day operational support and continuous improvement will transfer to this role. Leading a team of AI engineers provided through our strategic delivery partners, the AI Solutions Support Lead will ensure production AI solutions remain stable, performant, compliant, and aligned to evolving business needs. This role acts as the central coordination point between AI engineering, Data Science \& AI Delivery, Data Engineering, BTS, business stakeholders, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions continue to deliver measurable value throughout their lifecycle. The role combines technical leadership, operational excellence, stakeholder management, and people leadership, requiring an individual who is equally comfortable discussing model performance, coordinating incident response activities, managing enhancement roadmaps, and engaging senior business stakeholders. **What will you do in this role?** Own Production AI Solutions * Assume operational ownership of AI solutions following successful deployment and handover from delivery teams. * Establish and maintain support processes, documentation, runbooks, monitoring dashboards, escalation paths, defect management and operational procedures. once a solution has met agreed production acceptance criteria, including runbooks(those will need to be created and handed over to support team), monitoring dashboards, support ownership, escalation paths, defect management, and release evidence * Ensure clear ownership, accountability, and service management practices are in place for all production AI solutions. * Maintain an accurate inventory of supported solutions, dependencies, business owners, and support requirements. Lead AI Support \& Incident Management * Coordinate investigation and resolution of production issues affecting AI solutions. * Manage defect remediation activities and oversee the delivery of code fixes through internal and partner engineering teams. * Act as the primary point of coordination during major incidents impacting AI services. * Ensure issues are identified, triaged, prioritised, communicated, and resolved effectively. * Support post\-incident reviews and implementation of preventative actions. Monitor Solution Performance \& Effectiveness * Own monitoring frameworks to assess solution performance, reliability, usage, accuracy, cost, and value realization. * Monitor AI outputs for signs of performance degradation, model drift, bias, fairness concerns, or changing business effectiveness. * Ensure solutions continue to meet business objectives, operational requirements, and governance standards. * Identify optimisation opportunities and drive continuous improvement activities. Drive Continuous Improvement \& Enhancements * Own and manage enhancement backlogs for production AI solutions. * Coordinate development and deployment of approved enhancements. * Ensure solutions evolve in line with changing business processes, regulatory expectations, and technology capabilities. * Support release planning and production deployments. Collaborate Across Technology \& Data Teams * Work closely with the broader Data Science \& AI Delivery team to ensure effective transition of solutions into support. * Partner with Data Engineering teams to maintain data pipelines, integrations, and platform dependen : * High availability and reliability of production AI solutions. * Timely resolution of incidents and defects. * Strong stakeholder satisfaction with AI services and support. * Evidence that AI solutions continue to deliver expected business outcomes. * Effective monitoring and management of performance, fairness, bias, drift, and operational risk. * Delivery of enhancements and continuous improvements aligned to business priorities. * Smooth transition of solutions from delivery into operational support. * Well\-managed support teams and partner resources. **About You** You are an organised, technically strong leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of technology, operations, and business value. You have experience supporting complex production systems and can confidently coordinate multidisciplinary teams to resolve issues and drive continuous improvement. You combine strong technical understanding with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling you to translate business priorities into practical operational outcomes. **Skills \& Experience** Essential * Significant experience supporting, operating, or maintaining production AI, machine learning, analytics, or data\-driven solutions. * Strong understanding of AI solution lifecycles, including deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancement. * Experience leading technical teams and coordinating third\-party delivery partners. * Strong incident management and problem\-solving capabilities. * Experience managing application support, service management, or operational delivery functions. * Strong understanding of data platforms, APIs, cloud environments, and software delivery practices. * Experience working with Agile delivery methodologies and DevOps practices. * Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. * Ability to prioritise effectively and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously. * Strong organisational and leadership capabilities. **Desirable** * Experience supporting Generative AI, machine learning, large language model (LLM), or agentic AI solutions. * Experience with Azure AI, Databricks, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, Foundry, or similar AI technologies. * Understanding of Responsible AI principles, model monitoring, bias management, and AI governance requirements. * Experience within insurance, financial services, or other highly regulated industries. * Familiarity with ITIL, Service Management, or Site Reliability Engineering practices. **Working Arrangements** This role forms part of the operational backbone of AXIS' AI capability. Given the critical nature of production support responsibilities, occasional out\-of\-hours work, including evenings and weekends, may be required to support incident resolution, production deployments, testing activities, or other business\-critical operational events. **Role Factors:** In this role, you will typically be required to: Attend your local office at least three (3\) days per week to meet and build relationships with colleagues and the wider business. Engage in company activities to grow your network and build a strong team culture. **What we offer:** For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $175,000 \- $200,000 USD (New York, NY), $110,000 \- $130,000 CAD (Halifax, Nova Scotia) Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location. In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more. Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is Exempt for FLSA purposes. **This posting is for an existing vacancy.**

jobs.title: Field CTO - Data & Agentic Transformation, Google Cloud
jobs.description: **Who We Are** We're the Accenture Google Business Group Mid\-Market team, a specialized group of engineers, architects, and builders delivering tailored Google Cloud solutions for mid\-market, high\-growth, and fast\-paced enterprises. We partner with dynamic organizations to connect them with the right combination of Accenture solutions and Google Cloud products to accelerate business transformation and solve real\-world problems, quickly. We're expanding our team to meet the unique, rapid execution needs of the mid\-market segment. **The Domain** Data and AI are no longer back\-office functions — they're the engine of every modern business decision. And with the arrival of agentic AI, we're entering a new era: intelligent agents that don't just analyze data but act on it — automating complex workflows, making autonomous decisions, and transforming how companies operate. Google Cloud is leading this shift with the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Vertex AI, and the most powerful data stack in the industry. Our mid\-market clients need lean, agile leaders who can unlock massive amounts of untapped data and rapidly turn it into a distinct competitive advantage. **The Role** You're the person the client trusts to make it happen. As a Technical Delivery Lead, you own delivery from initial solution shaping through go\-live. You design the execution approach for data and AI engagements, lead the implementation, and ensure the final product fundamentally upgrades how the client leverages data and intelligent automation. You're supported by a dedicated offshore engineering team — you set the strategic direction, and they build alongside you. But you're the single point of accountability for what ships. This role is for an execution\-focused leader who takes full ownership of their work. You care deeply about delivery quality, data architecture outcomes, agent design, and speed\-to\-value for the business. You hold yourself to a higher standard than anyone else would. You'll work directly with client stakeholders — immersing yourself in their environment, understanding their fast\-evolving resource constraints, and delivering outcomes that matter in weeks, not quarters. You'll have the autonomy to shape how they experience the full power of Google Cloud's data and AI stack, from first conversation to go\-live. **What You'll Do** * **Own the delivery.** End\-to\-end. jobs.description: Achronix Semiconductor Corporation is a fabless semiconductor corporation based in Santa Clara, California, offering high\-performance FPGA solutions. jobs.title: Data Center Structural Engineer, AMER Design Engineering - East Regional Team
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Data Center Structural Engineer to join its design team in Herndon, Virginia. AWS designs, builds, and operates Data Centers (DC) around the world and is a leader in worldwide cloud\-computing infrastructure. Engineers in AWS work to design resilient, cost effective DC facilities. Our team is responsible for achieving a world class uptime for our customers and drive to develop a fleet of buildings emphasizing security, safety, efficiency, and cost effectiveness, while finding new ways to meet AWS’s growing demand. As a DC Structural Engineer at AWS, you will be part of the design team for Amazon DCs in our Americas Region and impact other projects around the world. As a Structural Engineer at AWS you will be part of a highly creative and efficient design team comprised of Architects, Engineers and Designers tasked with solving problems and challenging the status quo. As a subject matter expert, you will have a direct impact on the design of prototypical DC facilities, provide technical guidance to team members, review milestone drawings by consultants, solve large scale implementation issues, and be responsible for structural design requirements. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. About the team \*Why AWS\* Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. \*Diverse Experiences\* Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. \*Work/Life Balance\* We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. \*Inclusive Team Culture\* Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Avenue Z, Inc.** At Avenue Z, we are a dynamic media and technology company with a powerful influence across all channels. Our leadership has been at the forefront of digital marketing and communications for over 30 years, pioneering innovative strategies that drive meaningful change in brand performance and business growth. When you join Avenue Z, you become part of a team that doesn’t just adapt to change but leads it, guiding some of the world’s most influential leaders and brands to new heights. We are driven by a deep passion for our craft and an unwavering commitment to integrity in everything we do. If you share our passion and values, explore our current job openings to see how you can make an impact with us.**The role** ------------ We are hiring a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to build and ship the agent systems that run social commerce for our brands and for our own platform. You will embed with the teams doing the work, performance media, creator and influencer, ecommerce, and analytics, find the process where throughput is lost or money is left on the table, and build a production agent that owns it. Then you move to the next one. Concretely, this is work like: agents that detect and re\-authorize expiring TikTok Shop affiliate codes and Meta partnership permissions before spend stalls, systems that reallocate ad budget toward top\-performing creators automatically, pipelines that launch new creator content across every platform daily without a human touching it, and reporting infrastructure that tells a brand what actually drove GMV. You own the problem end to end: discovery, architecture, build, deploy, evals, adoption, and what breaks at 2am. If your instinct on a messy problem is to open an editor rather than schedule a working session, this is your role.**What you'll do** ------------------ * Embed with a business unit, diagnose where throughput or margin is lost, and ship a working agent against it inside the first few weeks. * Build production agent systems: tool use, planning loops, memory, retrieval, orchestration, and human\-in\-the\-loop approval gates where money or brand safety is on the line. * Integrate deeply against the commerce and ad platforms our revenue runs on: TikTok Shop and TikTok Ads, Meta and Instagram, Amazon, Shopify, Google, Snap, and affiliate and creator APIs. * Build data pipelines and analytics infrastructure that tie creator content, ad spend, and attributed GMV into one picture. * Build the evaluation harness alongside the agent. Nothing ships to production without a way to measure whether it is right. * Own the infrastructure: APIs, queues, auth and token refresh, observability, error handling, rate limits, and cost controls. * Instrument everything. Every system you ship gets tied to a number: hours returned, cycle time cut, spend efficiency, GMV or revenue supported. * Document it, drive adoption with the team that uses it, and keep improving it after launch. **Who you are** --------------- * Computer science or another technical background, or equivalent hands\-on experience as a developer or as a self\-taught AI\-native builder. We care about what you have shipped and whether it works, not where you learned it. * 3 to 5 years building and shipping software that other people depended on. * You can read, write, and debug Python or TypeScript. You have deployed and maintained real services and you understand what is happening underneath, whether you wrote every line yourself or built it alongside AI coding tools. * Hands\-on experience building LLM agent systems: function and tool calling, RAG, orchestration, prompt and context engineering, agent evals. * Real experience integrating third\-party marketing, ad, or commerce APIs. You know what OAuth token expiry, rate limiting, webhook replay, and undocumented API behavior actually cost you. * Comfortable with cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), containers, CI/CD, and SQL. * You work fluently with AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor. We expect you to build with them. We also expect you to be able to explain, debug, and defend what comes out of them. * You understand how performance marketing works: ROAS, CAC, attribution, creative testing, funnel mechanics, affiliate and creator economics. Or you can learn a domain fast and go deep, and you can prove it. * Entrepreneurial. You have built something of your own, a startup, a product, a side venture, an open source project, and can point to what you shipped and what it did. * High agency. You gather your own requirements, make the call, and ship. You do not wait for a spec, a committee, or a change management plan. * Able to sit with a senior executive or a brand's head of ecommerce, understand the business problem in their language, and translate it into a system without a translator in the room. **Nice to have:** direct experience with TikTok Shop, Meta Ads, or Amazon Seller/Ads APIs. Background at a DTC brand, an ecommerce platform, a creator or affiliate network, or a performance agency. Prior forward deployed, applied AI, or founding engineer experience. **Benefits*** Competitive salary range: $90,000 \- $100,000 USD * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans. * 401(k) plan with employer match. * Unlimited paid time off policy to support work\-life balance. * Professional development opportunities and budget. Please note that we do not offer Visa support of any type, and that the position is on\-site in Miami 4\-5 days per week.

jobs.title: Distributed Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Sunnyvale, CA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Software Engineering Cerebras Systems builds the world's largest AI chip, 56 times larger than GPUs. This architecture allows Cerebras to deliver industry\-leading training and inference speeds; over 10 times faster than GPU\-based hyperscale cloud inference services. This order of magnitude increase in speed is transforming the user experience of AI applications, unlocking real\-time iteration and increasing intelligence via additional agentic computation. Cerebras works with the leading model labs, global enterprises, and cutting\-edge AI\-native startups. OpenAI recently announced a multi\-year partnership with Cerebras, to deploy 750 megawatts of scale, transforming key workloads with ultra high\-speed inference. **The Role** The Cluster engineering team owns the software that turns thousands of wafers, servers, and switches into a cloud that stays up, stays busy, and stays debuggable. We stand clusters up from bare metal, schedule training and inference workloads across the fleet, keep it healthy, and make it observable to users, operators, and increasingly to AI agents. The stack is Go and Python on Kubernetes, running both on\-premise deployments and our own cloud. **Responsibilities** * Declarative, CRD\-driven automation of bare\-metal networking, OS, and application software across clusters of Cerebras systems, servers, and switches, built to reconcile thousands of nodes * Push\-button cluster install, upgrade, and security patching with real downtime budgets, gated by canaries * Kubernetes operators that schedule large inference workload: resource locks, priority queues, network topology, and health\-aware placement * gRPC control\-plane services, authorization, admission webhooks, and quota policy for a multi\-tenant fleet * Metrics and log pipelines with purpose\-built exporters for wafer\-scale systems, servers (Redfish, IPMI), and network fabric (gNMI, sFlow), on Prometheus and Grafana, with SLOs and alerting * Failure detection, HA control planes, and automated recovery, plus the CLIs, APIs, and MCP gateway that expose the fleet to users, operators, and AI agents **Skills and Qualifications** * 5\+ years building and operating production distributed systems or infrastructure software * Production\-quality Go and Python * Real Kubernetes depth: you have written or debugged controllers and operators, and you understand CRDs, reconciliation semantics, informer caches, admission webhooks, and RBAC * Strong debugging skills across distributed systems, Linux, and networking * Prometheus and Grafana as a practitioner: PromQL, exporter design, cardinality discipline, useful alerts * Strong self\-driving capability. This environment is large, fast\-moving, and not fully documented, so we need engineers who build their own context, decide, and drive work across team boundaries. Learning speed matters more here than familiarity with our stack. * Demonstrated adoption of AI in your engineering workflow: active use of coding agents, a view on where they help and where they mislead, and the rigor to verify what they produce. * Nice to have: bare\-metal or HPC fleet operations, scheduler internals, RDMA/RoCE and eBPF networking, Ceph or NVMe\-oF, etcd and HA upgrades, inference serving stacks. ML research experience is not required. **Why Join Cerebras** People who are serious about software make their own hardware. At Cerebras, we have built a breakthrough architecture that is unlocking new opportunities for the AI industry. With dozens of model releases and rapid growth, we’ve reached an inflection point in our business. Members of our team tell us there are five main reasons they joined Cerebras: * Build a breakthrough AI platform beyond the constraints of the GPU. * Publish and open source their cutting\-edge AI research. * Work on one of the fastest AI supercomputers in the world. * Enjoy job stability with startup vitality. * Our simple, non\-corporate work culture that respects individual beliefs. **Apply today and become part of the forefront of groundbreaking advancements in AI!** *Cerebras Systems is committed to creating an equal and diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate different backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe inclusive teams build better products and companies. We try every day to build a work environment that empowers people to do their best work through continuous learning, growth and support of those around them.*

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Data
jobs.description: **About Dune** Dune is on a mission to make crypto data accessible. We’re a collaborative multi\-chain analytics platform used by thousands of developers, analysts, \& investors to understand the on\-chain world and the frontiers of finance. We’re a team of \~60 employees, working together across Europe and eastern US timezones ️. We believe in our mission, and in building a powerful, open product that allows individuals and communities to do deep research into important ecosystems like Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and many more. We’re backed by some of the world's best investors. In February 2022, we announced our Series B funding round led by Coatue and Union Square Ventures, an important milestone that allowed us to double down on our mission. We’re using the funds to educate, reward and empower a new generation of onchain analysts aka Wizards If you want to have one of the highest impact jobs on the planet, come join our wonderful team of Galaxy brains. **Learn more about us:** Dune's Vision Values and working at Dune ### **About the role** Data Foundation owns how blockchain data enters Dune, how it is represented and how it’s delivered externally. This is a role that involves thinking about large distributed data systems, recognising traditional scaling patterns and software lifecycle pitfalls, and is ideal for anyone passionate about those topics. You will be the engineer we hand ambiguous product requirements to, and will be comfortable coming back with a design, a sequence, and a set of tasks the team can pick up as well as building the hardest parts yourself. ### **In this role you will** * Turn product requirements into technical requirements: model the domain, define the interfaces and the workflows, and navigate trade\-offs * Break large problems into work other engineers can own, and sequence it so we ship something useful early * Drive high\-impact architectural decisions across the data platform, and own components end to end from design through production * Work across our stack, mainly Go, Kotlin, Rust and Python where they fit, choosing the right tool rather than the familiar one * Design for correctness and performance under real volume: large\-scale ingestion, distributed processing, and data lake storage * Raise the bar on design reviews, testing, and how the team breaks work down * Mentor engineers by example, in a fully distributed team ### **You might be a great fit if** * You are a strong generalist with real computer science fundamentals, and you use them to adapt quickly to new technologies and problem spaces * You reason from first principles: you make assumptions explicit, identify the constraints and invariants that matter, and derive the solution rather than reaching for a familiar pattern. * You use computer science fundamentals as practical tools. You have designed and shipped distributed data systems, making their contracts, state transitions, invariants, and failure modes explicit. You know their fault models and scaling weaknesses * You are comfortable with ambiguity : you will talk to product, to customers, and to the team, then commit to a scope and defend it * You use AI tools well enough that they have changed how you work, you understand their failure modes and dislike ai\-slop. * You communicate clearly in writing and get the best out of a distributed team ### **Not required, but a plus** * Experience with data lakes and formats such as Parquet, Iceberg or Deltalog * Experience at a company where the data is the product **Perks \& Benefits** --------------------- * A competitive salary and equity package . Both salary and equity is top 25% of companies in the space * Our employee equity scheme has world\-class employee\-friendly terms with a heavily discounted strike price (\~90%) and a 10\-year exercise window * 5 weeks PTO \+ local public holidays (that can be swapped to suit you) * A fully remote\-first approach within a distributed team with flexible working hours; you structure your own day * Say goodbye to meeting overload! We believe in a healthy mix of async and sync work, so you can focus on what truly matters—no more wasted time on endless meetings! * Good health is important, so we offer private medical insurance, dental \& vision as standard * We believe in paid parental leave to help you celebrate this important milestone, transition to your new life, and bond with your new baby. We offer 16 weeks to primary and 6 weeks to secondary caregivers, fully paid. Plus a 2\-week part\-time phased return at full pay to help you get used to your new (and slightly more complex!) schedule * Quarterly offsites in various exciting locations as a company or team to connect, work together and have fun (so far in Tuscany Berlin Austria and Athens ). * On top of this each person gets a yearly travel allowance to connect and co\-work with someone or a team of people for a few days. * An allowance for your at\-home setup, to ensure you are happy, comfortable and productive. If you prefer a local co\-working space, we’ll pay for your desk. * Work with some of the best people you’ll ever get to meet! * And of course, you get some awesome Dune swag! \- We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. Secondary Responsibilities * Develop and maintain project management policies, standards, and best practices. * Create and update project templates, onboarding documents, runbooks, and delivery procedures. * Assist leadership with project forecasting, reporting, and strategic planning. * Analyze project metrics and recommend process improvements. * Collaborate with Service Delivery and Engineering leadership to improve project outcomes and team efficiency. * Support internal operational, technology, and process improvement initiatives. * Assist with client onboarding and major client lifecycle transitions when needed. * Participate in vendor coordination and project\-related procurement activities. * Complete role\-based training and maintain relevant certifications. QualificationsRequired * 3\+ years of project management experience, preferably within an MSP, IT services, consulting, or technology environment. * Strong understanding of project management methodologies and best practices. * Experience working with PSA, project management, documentation, and collaboration platforms. * Exceptional organizational, prioritization, and time management skills. * Strong verbal and written communication abilities. * Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines. * Experience coordinating cross\-functional technical teams. * Strong problem\-solving and conflict\-resolution skills. jobs.description: **About Finch** --------------- We believe every American household deserves access to counsel in life’s biggest moments. At Finch, we’re building the infrastructure to make justice radically more accessible. Our modern approach to consumer law automates the admin work and puts clients first, starting with personal injury. In just over a year, we've grown 10x, raised a $20M Series A, and become the pre\-litigation partner of choice for top personal injury firms across the country. We believe the best outcomes happen when expert operators and purpose\-built AI work together – which is why we handle every step of pre\-lit, from intake and claim opening to medical records, lien management, and demands, with humans leading every case. We’re backed by Sequoia, Redpoint, and the founders \& CEOs of generational companies like DoorDash, Ironclad, and Digits. We’re rebuilding how the law serves everyday Americans from first principles, and we’re hiring exceptional operators to help us scale it nationwide. **This Role** ------------- Personal injury law is drowning in repetitive tasks, paper\-based bottlenecks, and fragmented data. We're building the software to fix it. As a Member of the Technical Staff at Finch, you'll own critical features end\-to\-end, ship fast, and work directly alongside product, ops, and design in a codebase where your decisions matter from day one. **What You'll Do** ------------------ This is a full\-stack role at a company where the product is evolving quickly and engineers have real ownership – expect the scope to grow as we do. * Own major features end\-to\-end, from architecture decisions through production release. * Build reliable, performant systems across our core workflows using Python/Django, React, and AWS. * Ship AI\-powered functionality that turns legal complexity into clear, usable software for law firms. * Collaborate directly with product, ops, and design to define what gets built and why. * Shape our culture of our technical team, standards, and practices while we're still small enough for it to matter. **Who We Have in Mind** ----------------------- This role is for technical team members who want ownership over outcomes \- here's what we think that requires. ### **Must\-Haves** * 3\+ years building reliable, secure software in production. * Full\-stack experience – comfortable across the frontend and backend. * Proficiency in Python and React, or demonstrably fast at picking up new stacks. * A track record of writing clean, testable, maintainable code. ### **Nice\-to\-Haves** * Experience with Django, AWS, or OpenAI APIs. * Prior work at an early\-stage startup where you helped set engineering standards. * Familiarity with legal tech, document processing, or data\-heavy workflows. ### **This Role Might Not Be For You If** * You do your best work with a well\-defined spec and a stable, established codebase. * You prefer deep specialization in one layer of the stack over full\-stack ownership. * You're looking for a remote\-first role – this one is 4 days/week in our NYC office. **Benefits** ------------ * 100% coverage for health, dental, and vision. * 401(k) retirement plan. * In\-office snacks, drinks, and daily team lunches and dinners. * Flexible PTO (we trust you to take the time you need). **Interview Process** --------------------- * Intro: An initial call to see if there's a mutual fit. * Interview: Technical session with a member of the team. * Onsite: A visit to our NYC office to interview, meet the team, and have lunch. **At Finch Legal, we believe in practicing what we advocate.** -------------------------------------------------------------- As a company dedicated to upholding justice and protecting people in the workplace, we are equally committed to fostering a safe, inclusive, and equitable environment within our own walls. We welcome and support individuals from all backgrounds and lived experiences — regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or veteran status. We recognize that diversity strengthens our team, enriches our perspectives, and empowers us to better serve our clients and communities. At Finch Legal, inclusion isn’t just a value — it’s a practice. Compensation Range: $180K \- $280K

jobs.title: Senior Growth Engineer - Full-Stack Product Engineer
jobs.description: Senior Growth Engineer — Client Opportunity **Our client, Firecrawl, is hiring a Senior Growth Engineer for a full\-time opportunity in the San Francisco Bay Area, California.** **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Location:** San Francisco Bay Area, CA **Hiring:** 1–2 positions **Equity:** Competitive equity; details shared during the interview process About the Opportunity One of our clients, **Firecrawl**, is looking for a **Senior Growth Engineer** to join its engineering team and take ownership of the product experiences that drive developer adoption, activation, and conversion. This is a **full\-stack engineering role focused on Product\-Led Growth (PLG)**. You won't simply be building features and handing them off—you'll own the complete cycle from identifying a growth opportunity and forming a hypothesis to building the solution, running experiments, measuring results, and iterating based on what you learn. You'll work closely with product, engineering, data, and revenue leadership and will have direct ownership of measurable growth outcomes. About Firecrawl Firecrawl makes it easy to turn the web into data that AI agents can use. With a single API call, developers can convert any URL into clean, LLM\-ready markdown or structured data—solving a difficult problem that teams building with LLMs repeatedly encounter. Firecrawl reached **8 figures in ARR in its first year** and more than doubled ARR in its second year. Its open\-source project has earned **147K\+ GitHub stars**, and developers, AI agents, and leading AI companies use Firecrawl every day. Firecrawl is a small, high\-ownership team building infrastructure for the next generation of AI applications. The company operates at the frontier of AI infrastructure, building tools that help AI companies and developers gather and work with web data. About the RoleSenior Growth Engineer As a Senior Growth Engineer, you'll build the product experiences that turn developers discovering Firecrawl into active and engaged users. You'll own key parts of the developer journey, including: **Signup → Activation → Onboarding → Engagement → Conversion** You'll be expected to understand user behavior, identify friction in the funnel, develop hypotheses, build solutions, run experiments, and use data to determine what works. This role reports to the **VP of Revenue and Success** and offers significant ownership over growth\-focused product initiatives. What You'll DoOwn Growth Surfaces End\-to\-End * Own the signup, activation, onboarding, and conversion experiences. * Identify friction and opportunities across the developer journey. * Build product experiences that improve activation and conversion. * Take ownership from initial hypothesis through production deployment and measurement. Build and Ship Full\-Stack * Build production\-quality experiences across frontend and backend. * Work from the first developer\-facing interaction through the backend systems that power it. * Develop developer\-first product experiences rather than static marketing pages. * Collaborate with engineering and product teams to deliver quickly and reliably. Run Growth Experiments * Design and implement A/B tests and product experiments. * Develop hypotheses based on product data, user behavior, and qualitative feedback. * Define appropriate success metrics before launching experiments. * Analyze experiment results and determine what to scale, change, or discontinue. * Learn from experiments that don't produce the expected results. Own the Metrics * Treat activation, conversion, and other relevant funnel metrics as core engineering outcomes. * Instrument product experiences to measure user behavior. * Monitor funnel performance and identify growth levers. * Use SQL and product analytics to investigate user behavior. * Continuously iterate based on measurable results. Work With Data * Analyze product funnels and event data. * Identify drop\-off points and opportunities for improvement. * Translate data into actionable product hypotheses. * Work closely with product and growth stakeholders to prioritize opportunities. Partner With Leadership * Help shape the growth roadmap. * Work directly with product, engineering, data, and revenue leadership. * Bring technical and product perspectives to growth decisions. * Operate independently while keeping stakeholders aligned. Build for Developers * Create experiences that help developers discover, evaluate, integrate, and adopt Firecrawl. * Work with APIs, SDKs, documentation, playgrounds, and other developer\-facing surfaces. * Understand the needs and behaviors of technical users. * Optimize the developer experience throughout the product journey. What We're Looking For We're looking for a **strong full\-stack engineer who combines technical depth with product and growth instincts**. You should be someone who enjoys writing production code while also thinking about: * Why users sign up * Why they activate * Where they drop off * What makes them ado tivation rate * Product adoption * User engagement * Trial conversion * Upgrade conversion * Retention The specific metrics will depend on the initiatives you own. Working Style Firecrawl operates with a high level of urgency and ownership. The environment is fast\-moving, and priorities can evolve quickly as the company scales. The right candidate will be comfortable with: * High ownership * Ambiguous problems * Rapid experimentation * Frequent shipping * Data\-driven decision making * Direct collaboration with leadership * Learning from unsuccessful experiments * Using AI to accelerate development * Taking projects through to measurable outcomes If you enjoy environments where you can **build, measure, learn, and iterate quickly**, this role could be a strong fit. Compensation \& Equity This is a **full\-time opportunity** with competitive compensation and equity. **Equity:** Competitive equity; specific details will be discussed during the interview process. Work Authorization \& Visa Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. Firecrawl is open to considering candidates who may require a **visa transfer**, including eligible candidates currently working in the US under statuses such as **H\-1B or OPT**, subject to applicable legal and company requirements. Visa sponsorship or immigration support for candidates who do not currently have US work authorization is **not currently part of the standard hiring process**. Individual circumstances may be reviewed based on business needs and applicable legal requirements. Location **San Francisco Bay Area, California** Candidates should be able to work on\-site in the Bay Area. Candidates who are not currently located in the area should be willing to relocate. Application / Screening To help us evaluate your experience, please be prepared to provide: * **Current location** * **Work authorization status** * **Whether you can work on\-site in the San Francisco Bay Area** * **Whether you would be willing to relocate, if applicable** * **Years of full\-stack engineering experience** * **Experience with React, TypeScript, Next.js, and Node.js** * **Examples of PLG/growth features you personally built** * **Examples of A/B tests or growth experiments you personally ran** * **Metrics or measurable outcomes influenced by your work** * **Experience with product analytics, event tracking, and SQL** * **Experience building LLM\-powered products** * **Experience using AI coding tools such as Cursor, Copilot, or Claude Code** Interested? If you're a full\-stack engineer who enjoys **building production software, experimenting with product experiences, working with data, and directly influencing growth**, we'd like to hear from you. **Apply now to explore the Senior Growth Engineer opportunity with our client, Firecrawl.** Pay: $225,000\.00 \- $290,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Employee assistance program * Flexible schedule * Relocation assistance Application Question(s): * Describe a time you scoped and shipped something without a spec or PM. How did you decide what to build? * Walk me through a growth experiment or A/B test you designed and ran. What was the hypothesis, what happened, and what did you do when it won or lost? * How do you use AI coding tools day to day, and what is something you have built with LLMs? * This role is based in the San Francisco Bay Area. Are you currently able to work on\-site in the Bay Area? If not, would you be willing to relocate for the role? * What is your salary expectation? * How actively are you exploring new opportunities? * 1\. Tell me about a PLG feature you shipped end to end that measurably moved a metric. Name the feature, the metric, and the before and after. * Have you applied to or interviewed with Firecrawl within the past 6 months, either directly or through a recruitment/consulting firm? If yes, please share when you applied or interviewed and the outcome of the process. Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco Bay Area, CA

With over 1,400 global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 15 offices world\-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow. **Job Description** **Role Focus** This is a blended role spanning both the **Defensive Platform Builder** (AppSec \& CloudSec) and **Active Operational Defender** (PenTest \& SecOps) disciplines. Master's degree preferred. * **Core Experience:** 8\+ years of progressive security engineering experience, demonstrating deep expertise in either the defensive or offensive discipline alongside strong working fluency across both. **Technical Expertise \& Core Competencies** * **Cross\-Discipline Credibility:** Deep hands\-on seniority in application security, cloud architecture defense, penetration testing, or security operations, with the breadth to speak authoritatively across the entire function. * **Cloud, DevOps \& Tooling Stack:** Deep practical knowledge spanning public cloud topologies (AWS/Azure/GCP), containerization/orchestration, CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI), manual penetration testing, and forensic analysis tools. * **AI Security \& Cryptography:** Expert\-level understanding of the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, applied cryptography, and federated authentication architectures. * **Regulatory Compliance:** Practical experience aligning security controls with PCI\-DSS v4\.0, SOC 1, SOC 2, and DORA standards. * **Leadership Track Record:** Proven background mentoring engineers, shaping technical roadmaps, and influencing hiring and resourcing decisions. **Preferred Certifications** * **Cloud \& Architecture:** AWS Certified Security – Specialty, CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist), or CISSP. * **Offensive \& Red Team:** OSCP, OSCE, or SANS GXPN. * **Incident Response \& Defense:** GCIH or GCFA. * **Modern AI Security:** OffSec OSAI (Offensive Security AI Red Teamer). **Soft Skills \& Core Mindset** * **Dual Builder/Breaker Mindset:** Transitions seamlessly between establishing defensive architecture standards and directing offensive assurance operations. * **Executive Influence:** Leads with influence, skillfully prioritizing competing business priorities and presenting high\-impact risks to executive leadership. * **Crisis Management \& Mentorship:** Displays calm, analytical decision\-making under intense pressure, leveraging crisis scenarios to coach and guide engineers. * **Commercial Drive:** Balances technical risk reduction with enterprise enablement, positioning security as a revenue driver and business differentiator. **Additional Information** **Submit today and get started!** We are excited to get to know you! Throughout our process you can expect to meet different FlyMates including the Hiring Manager and other Flymates. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will walk you through the steps and be your “go\-to” person for questions. This is a highly collaborative team with close collaboration with various teams within the core AV organization including AV Infrastructure, Embodied AI, AV/AI Platform, Model Deployment, Middleware, OS, Sensor Applications, and Vehicle Integration. This role blends expertise in Software development, software optimization, managing and deploying HIL Services as a PaaS, and hardware\-aware engineering. **What you’ll be doing (Responsibilities)** ------------------------------------------- * Define and drive the long\-term technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for AV HIL software platforms and integration services across multiple products, programs, and development organizations. * Lead the design and evolution of highly scalable, reliable, observable, and hardware\-aware HIL capabilities that support AV software validation from development through deployment. * Establish architectural direction and technical standards for platform services, APIs, service reliability, test automation, performance, and operational excellence. * Own the most complex, ambiguous, and business\-critical technical problems spanning AV software, AI models, vehicle hardware, infrastructure, middleware, operating systems, and deployment pipelines. * Translate organizational and customer needs into clear technical strategies, measurable outcomes, platform requirements, and incremental delivery plans. * Influence technical decisions across the AV organization and build alignment among senior technical leaders, product stakeholders, and partner teams. * Deliver reliable software and platforms through strong engineering practices, including requirements generation, design reviews, continuous integration, automated testing, observability, issue management, release readiness, and operational support. * Identify opportunities to improve platform scalability, utilization, fidelity, developer productivity, and cost efficiency; define success metrics and drive sustained improvements. * Serve as a hands\-on technical leader who contributes to critical software designs and implementations while raising the engineering quality of the broader organization. * Mentor and develop engineers across experience levels, strengthen technical communities of practice, and help shape hiring and talent\-development strategies. * Represent AV HIL Software Platforms in cross\-functional architecture reviews and technical planning forums, communicating complex trade\-offs clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences. **Your Skills \& Abilities (Required Qualifications)** ------------------------------------------------------ * 10\+ years of experience designing, developing, and delivering production\-quality software systems, including significant experience leading large or highly complex technical initiatives. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field; Master’s or PhD preferred. * Expert software engineering and systems fundamentals, with strong coding ability in Python, C\+\+, or comparable languages. * Demonstrated ability to define and execute technical strategy for complex, distributed, hardware\-software systems with broad organizational impact. * Deep experience designing for scalability, performance, reliability, observability, maintainability, and operational excellence. * Experience developing and operating software in a Linux environment and working effectively across the full software development lifecycle. * Strong understanding of platform and service architecture, APIs, automation, CI/CD, test infrastructure, and production operations. * Proven ability to lead through influence, resolve cross\-team dependencies, build alignment, and make sound decisions in ambiguous environments. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate archite dependency management systems such as Bazel. * Experience with SQL and data systems used for test analytics, platform observability, or validation insights. * Experience establishing engineering standards, platform governance, technical roadmaps, or architecture review processes. * Demonstrated success mentoring senior engineers and influencing technical direction beyond a single team. **Compensation:** The compensation information is a good faith estimate only. It is based on what a successful applicant might be paid in accordance with applicable state laws. The compensation may not be representative for positions located outside of New York, Colorado, California, or Washington * **Compensation:** The expected base compensation for this role is $189,300 \-$290,000, Actual base compensation within the identified range will vary based on factors relevant to the position. * **Bonus Potential:** An incentive pay program offers payouts based on company performance, job level, and individual performance. * **Benefits:** GM offers a variety of health and wellbeing benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plan, sickness and accident benefits, life insurance, paid vacation \& holidays. **\#GM\-AV\-1** \&\#xa;\&\#xa;\&\#xa;\&\#xa;This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the selected candidate is expected to report to a specific location at least 3 times a week {or other frequency dictated by their manager}.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;The selected candidate will be required to travel \<25% for this role.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;This job may be eligible for relocation benefits.\&\#xa;\&\#xa; **About GM** Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all. **Why Join Us** We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team. **Benefits Overview** From day one, we're looking out for your well\-being–at work and at home–so you can focus on realizing your ambitions. Learn how GM supports a rewarding career that rewards you personally by visiting **Total Rewards resources** . **Non\-Discrimination and Equal Employment Opportunities (U.S.)** General Motors is committed to being a workplace that is not only free of unlawful discrimination, but one that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging. We strongly believe that providing an inclusive workplace creates an environment in which our employees can thrive and develop better products for our customers. All employment decisions are made on a non\-discriminatory basis without regard to sex, race, color, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, disability, pregnancy or maternity status, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran or protected veteran, or any other similarly protected status in accordance with federal, state and local laws. Applicants in the recruitment process may be required, where applicable, to successfully complete a role\-related assessment(s) and/or a pre\-employment screening prior to beginning employment. To learn more, visit **How we Hire** . **Accommodations** General Motors offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 1 year of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C, C\+\+, Java, JavaScript). * 1 year of experience with data structures and algorithms. * 1 year of experience implementing core ML concepts. * Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * 1 year of software development experience working on high\-throughput backend applications, information verification pipelines, or machine learning feature systems. * Experience developing accessible technologies. * Demonstrated proficiency in modern programming languages (C\+\+, Java, or Python) and foundational understanding of commercial grounding, multi\-modal AI systems, or online advertising platforms. * Proven track record of proactive engineering teamwork, debugging habits, and executing iterative quality improvement cycles in changing software teams. **About the job** ----------------- Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward. As a key member of a small and versatile team, you design, test, deploy and maintain software solutions. The Ads in AI Experiences team is responsible for one of the highest\-priority initiatives at Google: reinventing Search Ads for the AI era (AI Overview, AI Mode). We are building the tech stack, the user experience, and the business model simultaneously. Our mission is to ensure that, as the Search experience evolves with AI, we unlock new ways for users to discover and engage with businesses through seamless, next\-generation commercial experiences. We are a team of risk\-takers and builders, responsible for experimenting with rapid velocity to define the next decade of Google’s business engine. Google Ads is helping power the open internet with the best technology that connects and creates value for people, publishers, advertisers, and Google. We’re made up of multiple teams, building Google’s Advertising products including search, display, shopping, travel and video advertising, as well as analytics. Our teams create trusted experiences between people and businesses with useful ads. We help grow businesses of all sizes from small businesses, to large brands, to YouTube creators, with effective advertiser tools that deliver measurable results. We also enable Google to engage with customers at scale. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $123000 \- $174000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Write clean, highly efficient, and well\-tested code in C\+\+, Java, or Python to support real\-time offer verification, commercial fact\-checking pipelines, and inventory grounding. * Participate in factuality quality hill\-climbing sprints by evaluating automated LLM\-as\-a\-Rater verification outputs, diagnosing offer mismatch discrepancies, and refining precision heuristics. * Implement ML feature pipelines and backend integrations that empower Search, Assistant, and Gemini surfaces to accurately corroborate commercial claims against authoritative merchant feeds. * Partner with executive corroboration modeling leads and cross\-functional teammates to rapidly triage verification latency errors, optimize factual accuracy, and sustain high sprint development velocity. * Architect Google's presentation and rendering pipelines to write code that enables Search, Assistant, and Gemini surfaces to render multi\-modal ad formats, partnering with technical leads and multi\-disciplinary mentors to directly improve visual ad quality and user delight. jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience in software development. * 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products, and 3 years of experience with software design and architecture. * 5 years of experience with one or more of the following: speech/audio (e.g., technology duplicating and responding to the human voice), reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field. * 5 years of experience with ML design and ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging, fine tuning). * Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. * 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms. * 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction. * Experience with low\-level accelerator programming and compilation toolchains (e.g., XLA, Pallas, CUDA, Triton, or custom TPU kernels). * Proven ability to lead rapid prototyping pods (SWAT/FDE) in highly ambiguous environments and influence VP/Director\-level technical roadmaps. * Demonstrated track record of optimizing large\-scale production ML serving or training systems resulting in measurable, compute/cost savings. **About the job** ----------------- Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions. You will operate as an "ambiguity buster," taking nebulous VP\-level mandates around compute constraints, latency spikes, and infrastructure scaling costs, and translating them into crisp, mathematically validated engineering solutions. Trading long\-term maintenance of legacy systems for continuous zero\-to\-one pathfinding velocity, you will lead Strike Sprints and embedded FDE engagements across Google. US: $207000 \- $300000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Lead technical architecture and system design for complex 1–6\-month Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) embeds and 2–4\-week Strike Sprints targeting high\-leverage Machine Learning efficiency bottlenecks. * Design, prototype, and write robust production C\+\+ and Python code for model compression, speculative decoding engines, dynamic batching layers, and high\-throughput serving pipelines. * Diagnose subtle distributed latency and throughput bottlenecks across XManager, Pathways, and Tensor Processing Unit/Graphics Processing Unit clusters, implementing low\-level kernel and memory optimizations (accelerated linear algebra (XLA), Pallas, Custom Ops). * Deconstruct ill\-defined executive mandates ("The Hot Plate") into rigorous efficiency scopes within strict latency, floating point operations (FLOPs), and tokenomics thresholds—delivering compelling thinnest viable proofs (TVPs). * Design automated distillation, pruning, and quantization (FP8/INT4\) pipelines that convert massive foundation models into compact, ultra\-efficient student models without compromising evaluation benchmarks. jobs.description: In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include: * Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance * Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match * Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6\.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment * Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance * Maternity Leave (Short\-Term Disability \+ Baby Bonding): 28\-30 weeks * Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks * Holidays: 13 paid days per year Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Kirkland, WA, USA; Seattle, WA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience with security assessments, security design reviews, or threat modeling. * 8 years of experience with security engineering, computer and network security and security protocols. * 8 years of coding experience in one or more general purpose languages. 3 years of experience with Cloud Security. * ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience building, scaling, or deploying machine learning models on enterprise AI platforms. * Experience scaling security impact using AI native solutions. * Experience utilizing static code analysis tools to maintain code quality, security, and performance. * Understanding of hardware architecture, particularly how software interacts with compute accelerators like GPUs or TPUs. * Ability to implement code automation practices, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code. **About the job** ----------------- Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities. jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description: **Experience:** Director **Salary:** $150,000 \- $200,000 per year **Job Details** \- Our company is seeking a dynamic and visionary Permanent Chief of Staff to join our Tech Services team. This is an incredible opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our organization. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing high\-level operations, creating and implementing strategic plans, and ensuring that our organization is always on the cutting edge of the tech services industry. This role requires a minimum of 5\+ years of experience in a similar leadership role. Responsibilities: As the Permanent Chief of Staff, you will be responsible for: 1\. Providing executive leadership to our team, driving the vision, strategy, and goals of the organization. 2\. Coordinating and managing the day\-to\-day operations of the organization, ensuring that all departments are working in harmony towards our shared goals. 3\. Developing and implementing strategic plans that align with the organization's mission and vision. 4\. Collaborating with other executive leaders to identify opportunities for growth and improvement. 5\. Keeping abreast of industry trends and changes, ensuring that our organization remains competitive and innovative. 6\. Representing the organization at industry events, conferences, and meetings. 7\. Overseeing the development and implementation of policies and procedures that promote the company culture and vision. 8\. Ensuring all legal and regulatory documents are filed and monitor compliance with laws and regulations. 9\. Working with the executive board to determine values and mission, and plan for short and long\-term goals. 10\. Identifying and addressing problems and opportunities for the company. Qualifications: The ideal candidate for the Permanent Chief of Staff position will have: 1\. A minimum of 5\+ years of experience in an executive leadership role within the tech services industry. 2\. Proven experience in developing and implementing strategic plans. 3\. Strong understanding of industry trends and changes. 4\. Exceptional leadership skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a team. 5\. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 6\. Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to make critical decisions under pressure. 7\. A demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously. 8\. Strong understanding of corporate finance and performance management principles. 9\. Familiarity with diverse business functions such as marketing, PR, finance etc. 10\. In\-depth knowledge of corporate governance and general management best practices. 11\. An entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding organizational and leadership skills. 12\. Analytical abilities and problem\-solving skills. 13\. Excellent communication and public speaking skills. 14\. MSc/MA in business administration or relevant field. Join us and be a part of a team that is dedicated to creating and implementing innovative tech solutions. This is a great opportunity to lead, grow, and make a significant impact on the future of our organization. **A bit about us:** \- We're a fast\-growing technology company on a mission to transform how the world's factories and frontline operations run. Our platform gives manufacturing and industrial teams the ability to build their own custom software — digital work instructions, quality checklists, machine monitoring, production tracking — without needing a team of developers. The result: frontline workers who have spent decades relying on paper, spreadsheets, and tribal knowledge finally get modern, connected tools built for how they actually work. Founded by a small team of engineers with deep roots in robotics and human\-computer interaction, we've grown from an early\-stage idea into a venture\-backed company trusted by manufacturers around the world, with tens of millions of dollars raised from leading investors. We're still early enough that everyone on the team shapes what we become next, and ambitious enough that the work has real, visible impact on the industrial economy. **Why join us?** \- We're hiring a Chief of Staff to work directly with our leadership team as we scale. This is a rare seat: you'll get a bird's\-eye view of the entire business, partner on the highest\-priority strategic initiatives, and help turn ambiguous problems into clear plans and execution. It's the kind of role that builds a foundation for future leadership positions — whether that's inside our company or wherever your career takes you next. What makes this opportunity worth considering: Direct, daily partnership with executive leadership on the decisions that matter most. Broad exposure across strategy, operations, hiring, and cross\-functional projects — not a narrow lane. A high\-growth, mission\-driven company solving a real, unglamorous problem for an industry (manufacturing) that badly needs modern tools. A culture that values ownership, directness, and getting things done over titles and hierarchy. The chance to shape processes and systems while the company is still small enough that your fingerprints stay on them. If you're energized by ambiguity, enjoy being the person who makes a complex organization run smoothly, and want a front\-row seat to building a category\-defining company, we'd love to talk. \#operations \#operations \#executive\-leadership \#chief\-of\-staff \#tier1

jobs.title: 2027 Spring Co-op - Operations Planning Engineer
jobs.description: **What You’ll Do:** As our **Operations Planning Engineer Co\-op**, you’ll get a front\-row seat to how one of the world’s largest electric grids is planned and operated. Think of Operations Planning a little like state patrol officers monitoring a busy interstate. They watch traffic conditions, identify congestion, help keep things moving safely, and respond when challenges arise. Our team does something similar with electricity — monitoring conditions across the Bulk Electric System (BES), evaluating how power can safely move across the grid, and helping to ensure electricity continues to flow reliably to the millions of people who depend on it. You’ll support the outage planning processes for a complex electric system spanning 15 states, analyzing future grid conditions and helping determine safe and reliable paths for maintenance, construction, and other changes to the system. **You’ll gain hands\-on experience with:** * Power system analysis tools and industry\-standard grid modeling software * Real\-world contingency analysis and system studies * Transmission outage planning and reliability analysis * Model validation and operational project support * Tools and technologies used every day to support real\-world grid operations **A Great Day in This Role Means:** You’ll spend time running power flow studies, reviewing system models, and evaluating how planned transmission outages could affect the grid. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers to analyze contingencies, identify potential reliability concerns, and determine what actions may be needed to keep electricity flowing safely and reliably. This is a fast\-paced environment where the work can have an immediate and meaningful impact. You’ll see how your analysis helps MISO plan maintenance, support new infrastructure projects, manage changing grid conditions, and prepare for challenges before they happen. **This is a unique opportunity because:** The electric grid is incredibly complex, and there is a lot to learn — but you won’t be learning it from a textbook alone. You’ll work alongside teams across Operations Planning, Real\-Time Operations, Day Ahead Market Operations, Transmission Planning, and other areas responsible for maintaining system reliability and supporting MISO’s energy markets. That cross\-functional exposure will help you understand not only how the grid works, but how engineering, operations, and markets come together to keep electricity moving across a massive interconnected system. **What You’ll Be Proud to Share:** * Supported power system studies evaluating future grid conditions, transmission outages, and reliability risks * Gained hands\-on experience with industry\-standard grid modeling and power flow analysis tools * Learned how engineers manage congestion and changing conditions across the Bulk Electric System * Collaborated with engineering and operations teams responsible for keeping electricity reliable across the MISO region * Applied classroom engineering concepts to real\-world challenges affecting millions of electricity consumers As part of your capstone experience, you’ll also present a concise summary demonstrating how your project contributes to the daily operational needs of grid management — giving you an opportunity to showcase what you learned and the real\-world impact of your work. **Qualifications at a Glance:** **Term:** January 13 – April 30, 2027 \| Full\-time \| Paid **Location:** Eagan, MN \| Housing available for qualified students **Academic Level:** Undergraduate (Juniors or Seniors) **Degree:** Electrical Engineering **Required Technical Skills:** * + Completion of core Electrical Engineering coursework **Preferred Skills:** * + Coursework in Power Systems Analysis + Programming experience such as Python, MATLAB, or C\+\+ + Hands\-on projects or internships related to grid modeling or system studies **By the End of Your Co\-op, You’ll Walk Away With:** * A foundational understanding of the Bulk Electric System and how a large\-scale electric grid operates * Hands\-on experience with contingency analysis, outage planning, and power system modeling tools * A better understanding of MISO’s role in maintaining reliability and operating energy markets * The ability to connect your Electrical Engineering coursework to real\-world grid challenges * Professional experience collaborating across engineering, operations, planning, and market teams **About MISO** MISO manages the electricity superhighway in the Central U.S. Through groundbreaking research and advanced technology, our highly skilled employees ensure that power flows reliably to 47 million customers. Operating the electricity grid, running a robust energy market, and planning for a bright future — it’s what our immensely talented and dedicated team does every day. **Plug into your future career. Apply today and help us keep the power flowing!** **Learn More About MISO’s Early Career Talent Programs:** Learn More about MISO's Internship \& Co\-op Opportunities (https://careers.misoenergy.org/internships\-coops/) Internship Experience Video (https://vimeo.com/850305007/3f99504627\) MISO, The Work We Do (https://vimeo.com/935124142/5c8d23402d) Follow Us on LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/midcontinent\-iso/life/e1d95e01\-cc94\-42ac\-bc0a\-57e43b39352f/?viewAsMember\=true) Apply Here!
